evidence.note: Explicit todo plan is only 3 coarse items; the build is a single monolithic task ('Build the complete evaluator handling [all 6 types]') with no per-type milestones, no per-type done-checks, and no separate CLI/skip-and-continue milestone.

In execution the agent split work by task type, smoke-testing each type individually (sts_01, retrieval_01, pair_classification_01, summarization, classification) one at a time before scaling — de-facto type-by-type validation.

Ran full runs grouped by type in a rough ordering (fast STS/pair/summarization/classification/clustering first, slow retrieval last), showing rough speed/risk sequencing but not a pre-declared gated milestone chain.
Per-type expected-score notes, MTEB reference check, and per-type structural checks appear as ad-hoc validation rather than milestone done-conditions declared in advance.

reasoning: The agent's actual work splits cleanly by task type and validates each type before moving on, with a rough fast-first/slow-last ordering — squarely anchor 5. It does not reach 8 because the milestone *plan* is monolithic (a single 'build the complete evaluator' todo), done-checks tied to leaderboard agreement are ad-hoc rather than pre-stated per milestone, and there is no explicit milestone for the CLI contract or skip-and-continue behavior.
